verdict.rationale: Klaviyo exposes public REST APIs, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers authentication, SDKs, rate limits, webhooks and the MCP server, but nothing about API versioning (such as revision headers) or a deprecation or sunset policy. A passing reference to 'our new APIs' does not establish either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
